home_title: BAFU/UVEK inventory database: community findings · Sentier
description: Users of the BAFU/UVEK life-cycle inventory database record measured findings here, repeat each other's measurements and report them to BAFU.

documents.title: Findings
documents.description: Measured observations about BAFU's inventory data. Each finding has a status, a record and a public place where it is discussed.

documents.title: Feedback to BAFU
documents.description: What was reported to BAFU and when, what BAFU answered, what is resolved, and what is ready to be reported.

documents.title: Contributions
documents.description: Proposals that go beyond a single finding: mappings, models, rebuilt inventories and method variants, each with its checks and reviewers.

documents.title: Patch and build
documents.description: How a change is applied to a copy of BAFU's release: the last build, step by step and line for line, what stands in the way of its use, and how to run it yourself.

documents.title: Take part
documents.description: Report a finding, repeat a measurement or propose a contribution. Everything is discussed in public on GitHub.

documents.title: Data and terms
documents.description: A short reading of BAFU's Terms of Use for people who work with the data here. It is not legal advice.

documents.title: How builds are checked
documents.description: What was measured about the import of BAFU's release: row accounting, factor coverage and a score comparison with BAFU's published results.

documents.title: Data (JSON)
documents.description: The findings, datasets and contributions of this site as JSON files for other tools, with their schemas and a feed of changes.
